newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar trade shut for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar trade shut for Hindu festival.

text.p: India's sugar trade was closed on Wednesday for a Hindu festival, dealers said. Trading will resume on Thursday.

On Tuesday, sugar prices dipped on sluggish consumer demand despite the coming festival season, dealers said. In ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 5.0 rupees to 1,360/1,390 rupees per quintal while M-30 slid by 10 rupees to 1,390/1,430 rupees.
"Seasonal demand in the open market remained at low ebb due to improved supplies of sugar pumped in by the government in the public distribution system," a broker said.
